06/26/2024 04:51;61536ea272f6970069fc1dbd;Hi Andrea,

I hope you are doing well. I wanted to talk to you about the ticket you submitted. I apologize for the delay. One of my team members brought up your concerns regarding some items you received from us. After discussing your concerns about the salad dressing with my management and the Food Sourcing Team responsible for all the food that comes into the Food Bank, here are some points I wanted to share with you.

Regarding the salad dressing, our Food Resourcing Team does not have a specific recommendation for shelf-stable milk or salad dressing in our Food Coding Guide. We suggest following the USDA's recommendation regarding this product specifically and apologize for not being able to provide further insight. Partners and clients should use their eyes, noses, and, taste buds to determine if a food is spoiled and therefore unsafe to eat. Of course, if a product is showing any signs of spoilage such as rot, mold, foul odor, etc., we will accept a return. I have brought this issue to management's attention, and I agree that our Food Coding Guide needs improvement. I will raise this with our leadership for further review.

In response to your second point, I acknowledge the importance of best-by dates for our partners and their clients. However, our team faces challenges in obtaining these dates for donated products. One challenge arises during packing events when volunteers check and pack donated items into cases labeled as assorted on the menu. These assorted cases contain items from various donors and are packed without specific best-by date information for each individual product. Another challenge occurs when we receive donated products in different case lots-with different dates, making it difficult to provide accurate best-by dates to our partners. We don't know what case lot your order is going to be pulled from until its pulled the day before or two before its delivered or picked up. Although we practice FIFO (first in, first out) inventory management, the dynamic nature of our inventory makes it challenging to predict best-by dates with certainty. As our inventory of donated products increases, we are committed to improving our processes to provide partners with the information they need to make informed decisions. We are continuously seeking ways to improve our processes, and I encourage partners to participate in the upcoming  Partner meetings in July to address any questions or recommendations regarding product dates.

Thank you for bringing these concerns to our attention.

Warm regards,

description: The deadline on our grant (FY24 MD Region MOCO 1-H) for $3,097.61 is May 27, 2024. When we tried to enter an order to use up that grant there were no delivery times available before May 27, because of the holiday weekend. We spoke with Charity in Partner Support and she told us to submit our order with a May 28 delivery day and then email you to get the deadline extended by a day. In addition to extending the deadline, please have your finance department deduct the order from the above mentioned grant. The computer automatically deducted it from our next MOCO grant which expires in June. I apologize for causing you extra work. Thank you for your assistance. Don't hesitate to call if you have any questions. Terry C: 240-793-5108

description: Hello we can take our delivery on 5/28 instead of 5/27 On Mon, May 13, 2024 at 4:10â€¯PM Partner Support wrote: Dear Partners, We hope this message finds you well. We are reaching out to you today because we have discovered a system error that mistakenly marked Tuesday, May 28th as Memorial Day instead of Monday, May 27th. As a result, some of you were able to place an order for that day. We apologize for any confusion this may have caused. Please be advised that on the actual day of Memorial Day - Monday, May 27th - Capital Area Food Bank will be closed. Because of this, we will need to move the day of your delivery to ensure that you receive your order on a different day that works with your schedule. In order to make this change as quickly as possible, please respond to this message at your earliest convenience with the most convenient day for your delivery. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Thank you for your patience and cooperation. Sincerely, Partner Support !image001.png|thumbnail! * *DH* * Manager of Customer Relations & Distribution Network Evolution Capital Area Food Bank * *P.* * 571.390.9875 | *F.* 703.541.0179 !image002.png|thumbnail! !image003.png|thumbnail! !image004.png|thumbnail! !image005.png|thumbnail! description: Yes! tuesday the 28th in the earliest slot please! Thank you so much. On Mon, May 13, 2024 at 16:10 Partner Support wrote: Dear Partners, We hope this message finds you well. We are reaching out to you today because we have discovered a system error that mistakenly marked Tuesday, May 28th as Memorial Day instead of Monday, May 27th. As a result, some of you were able to place an order for that day. We apologize for any confusion this may have caused. Please be advised that on the actual day of Memorial Day - Monday, May 27th - Capital Area Food Bank will be closed. Because of this, we will need to move the day of your delivery to ensure that you receive your order on a different day that works with your schedule. In order to make this change as quickly as possible, please respond to this message at your earliest convenience with the most convenient day for your delivery. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Thank you for your patience and cooperation. Sincerely, Partner Support !image001.png|thumbnail! * *DH* * Manager of Customer Relations & Distribution Network Evolution Capital Area Food Bank * *P.* * 571.390.9875 | *F.* 703.541.0179 !image002.png|thumbnail! !image003.png|thumbnail! !image004.png|thumbnail! !image005.png|thumbnail! description: h3. h3. h3. Hi, h3. I saw the post in the newletter and on the site. When can we place an order for 6/7 deliveries? The next day is a scheduled distribution day for us. Seeking to reserve a delivery slot for 6/7. RE: h3. h3. VA PARTNERLINK AGENCY NEWS h3. JUNE 7TH, CAFB IS CLOSING EARLY On June 7th, the Capital Area Food Bank will be closing early. Only the 8am-10am delivery and 8am, 9am, and 10am pickup slots will be available. This will also affect the puller's schedule on Monday, June 10th, resulting in limited delivery and pickup windows. Plan your orders accordingly and feel free to contact us at if you have any questions. Thank you! Jeff/Sterling UMC

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to inform you that you can only apply one grant for a single line item. The system was trying to use the last of your 1-H Grant to cover the line for your peaches (#300387), but your 1-H Grant only had $316.14 left on it, which left a balance of *$505.46* and the same with the line with your macaroni and cheese (#300015), the system is trying to use the last of what was on your 1-G which was $141.07 but the line item had a total of $385.60 leaving a balance of *$244.53*. 

 However, if you would like to use your other grant, Grant 1-I, which has a larger balance and can cover the entire line item costs we can arrange that for you so that you won't have any remaining balance to pay for this sales order.

Please let me know which grant you would like to use, and I will put in a ticket with my IT team to make the necessary changes.

Thank you,

Daniele

Our system applies grants on a per-line-item basis, which means that only one grant can be applied to each line item. In the case of your order, the line item is $817.00, and the system initially used the last of your FY24 MD Region Moco 1-G grant, which was $75.59. 

However, as per your request, I have contacted our IT department to apply your FY24 MD Region MOCO 1-I grant to that line item since it is the only grant you have that can cover the entire amount.

I hope this clarifies the situation. If you have any more questions, please feel free to ask.

*_Rolled Biscuits: Yield 6-8 biscuits. 1 pkg Jack & the Beanstalk Buttermilk Biscuit Mix, 1/2 cup water, preheat oven to 450 degrees F. Blend biscuit mix and water to a soft dough. Drop Biscuits: Follow recipe above except do not knead. Drop by spoonful onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10-12 minutes._*

(for maximum crown on muffins let batter rest for 3 or 4 minutes, stir lightly before filling cups.) Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown._*
